summary.tldr: Exempts psychotherapy and mental health counselling services from the GST.
what_it_does: Exempts psychotherapy services from goods and services tax under the Excise Tax Act.
Exempts mental health counselling services from goods and services tax.
Expands the GST exemption rules so the definition of “practitioner” covers these services and other listed health services.
summary.background: The bill amends the Excise Tax Act. It comes into force six months after royal assent.
